hypothesis: The supervisor-routed response relay's four-phase JSON re-materialization (from_slice parse + from_value per-key-clone walk + response_line deep clone + client-line to_string, ~28-40ms at 4.3-9.5MB wire per the decomposition record 20260926-193000) is removable: routing needs only the frame header's requestId plus the attach-family bookkeeping scalars, and the worker's own response_line bytes with the client id spliced in front are byte-identical to what the typed path emits (splice oracle proven on the same fixtures).
approach: CANDIDATE: zero-copy routed response relay. WorkerReply::Relayed carries the worker's response payload BYTES + ok/activeSessionId hints from the response frame's routing header (worker emits them for the attach family); the supervisor reader pump hands them to the route unparsed; route_client_command splices the client command id ('{"id":"<cid>",' + payload[1:]) and the connection writer emits raw bytes; attach-family bookkeeping runs from the header hints; the client-capabilities echo moves to the worker (routed attach request carries clientCapabilities; direct path unchanged). Typed path retained for chunked-snapshot attach clients, rebound reattach (command echo rewrite), detach/kill/rename/promote-owned forms, and every supervisor-internal route (route_command_typed parses back).
